propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the closed beta programme on the beta environment for four features with invited customer accounts, running the readiness checklist and weekly feedback triage.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the checklist document the betas and their environment.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the beta exit report for each feature, listing the beta environment's limitations, unresolved feedback and hand-over conditions.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the exit report document the reports.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate launched features to the whole customer base through staged rollouts and handled the rollback decisions.
propositions.rationale: The resume confines the candidate to the closed beta and places the staged rollout, launch monitoring and rollback calls with release management and SRE; her screen remarks about launch calls are her own account.

expectedGap: The materials document closed betas on the beta environment; they do not document the candidate launching to the general customer base, owning a rollout schedule or making rollback decisions.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the stage the resume names: closed beta with invited accounts; staged rollout, launch monitoring and rollback belonged to release management and SRE.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever owned a staged rollout to all customers or a rollback decision herself, and for which feature.
